private static boolean isParameterSeparator(final char c){
    // Separators are whitespace characters and various punctuation that cannot appear in a
    // Java identifier. This covers common separators used in parameter lists like commas,
    // parentheses, brackets, braces, etc.
    switch (c) {
        case ' ':
        case '\t':
        case '\r':
        case '\n':
            return true;
        case ',':
        case ';':
        case '(':
        case ')':
        case '[':
        case ']':
        case '{':
        case '}':
        case '<':
        case '>':
        case ':':
        case '=':
        case '|':
        case '&':
        case '*':
        case '^':
        case '+':
        case '-':
        case '/':
        case '\\':
        case '\'':
        case '\"':
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
    }
}
